text:
What do I care if my earthly fate does not

hold within me more than a small

thing of this earth? What do I care if years

of love are forgotten in a moment of hatred?


--


I do not weep in any way because the desolate

are happier than I, little one, but

because I see that you grieve over the fate of this one

who is only a passerby on the earth...

translation.title: To Miss ***
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the fragmentary address and the dash break from the Spanish catalog text.
